The '''Xanaqu South Industrial State Cooperation''', abbreviated '''XSISC''', is a state-owned industrial enterprise of the [[People's Federation of Xanaqu]]. The extracted source describes it as both a civilian and military manufacturer and as a major institution in Xanaqu's post-1936 industrialization.

This local draft treats XSISC as a 1994-back industrial anchor, not as a full modern corporate profile. Later post-1994 globalization and high-technology claims should be reviewed separately before publication.

== Foundation ==

XSISC was founded in 1952 as part of a nationwide effort to build a self-sufficient industrial base after the formation of the People's Federation. Its early work focused on heavy industry, machinery, steel, basic consumer goods, and other production needed by a state trying to reduce dependence on foreign manufacturing.

The source places the company under government direction and ties it to the state-centered economic model described in Xanaqu's national article.

== Expansion ==

During the 1960s and early 1970s, XSISC expanded into electronics, automotive manufacturing, chemical production, and early defense work. The source describes close ties with other state enterprises and academic institutions, suggesting that XSISC functioned as part of a broader planned-industrial network rather than a stand-alone private firm.

By the late 1970s and 1980s, regional tensions and military modernization pushed the company further into defense manufacturing, research, armored vehicles, aircraft, and other military-industrial work.

== Structure ==

The source lists four broad divisions: military manufacturing, civilian manufacturing, research and development, and logistics or supply chain management. Current drafts route ministerial oversight through the [[Xanaqu Ministry of Industry and Technology]], but that ministry's exact legal powers remain open.

The source also uses both "Red Army" language in the Xanaqu national article and "People's Liberation Army" language in the XSISC article. Until canon settles the terminology, local drafts treat [[Red Army of Xanaqu]] as the safest 1994-back military title and preserve People's Liberation Army as a source wording issue.

== 1990s Modernization ==

The source says the 1990s brought foreign partnerships, automation, telecommunications, and the development of the [[XSISC Semiconductor Plant]]. Because the current porting pass stops at 1994, this draft treats those developments as early-1990s trajectories only. Exact completion dates, partners, and product lines need review before they become fixed canon.
